name: TPC Harding Park
note: Municipal course on Spring Valley Water Co. land by Lake Merced, opened 1925.

name: Lincoln Park Golf Course
note: A three-hole layout was laid out in 1902 on part of the City (Golden Gate) Cemetery, but the land only went to the Park Commission in 1909, when the graves began to be moved; 14 holes by 1914, 18 by 1917. Dated 1909 (was 1902) so the fairways do not cover the cemetery.

name: Presidio Golf Course
note: Opened 1895 by the San Francisco Golf Club on Army land; one of the oldest courses west of the Mississippi.

name: San Francisco Golf Club
note: Club moved to this Lake Merced site in the 1910s (Tillinghast course); year ESTIMATED 1915.

name: Olympic Club Lake Course
note: Olympic Club acquired Lakeside Golf Club 1918; Lake and Ocean courses opened 1924 (rebuilt 1927).

name: Lake Merced Golf and Country Club
Gleneagles Golf Course
note: 9-hole course in McLaren Park, opened 1962 (golf directory).

name: Golden Gate Park Golf Course
note: 9-hole course near the west end of the park, opened 1951.

name: Sharp Park Golf Course
note: San Francisco's municipal course in Pacifica (Alister MacKenzie), opened 1932 on Honora Sharp's bequest of 1917.
